title: Dog breed lifespan figures from four open-access studies
description:
Median lifespan and life expectancy by dog breed, as published in four open-access (CC BY 4.0) studies, one row per study and breed.

Site built on this data: https://dog-breed-data.at01.io/
Source repository, with columns, sources and how it was checked: https://github.com/JasonTKG/dog-breed-data
